name: Yuuri Mimori
source: Yuuri is a beginner just assigned to the LWC. He has a fair and somewhat feminine appearance, and his manner is soft and gentle. He is ill with a strange illness that causes his body to slowly deteriorate if he does not take medicine for it regularly. Since joining the LWC, he has been plagued by a strange recurring dream.
